name: StreamIndicator
title: Citizen stream assessment indicators
description: Indicators of a representative citizen-science stream assessment. Example canonical URL; these are NOT official HL7, LOINC or SNOMED CT codes.

concept.definition: Grouping observation for one citizen visit to a stream site.
Visual score 1-10 of how natural the channel shape is (10 = natural, 1 = concrete or straightened).
Visual score 1-10 of bank erosion (10 = stable vegetated banks, 1 = actively collapsing).
Visual score 1-10 of the vegetated strip along the stream (10 = wide native vegetation, 1 = none).
Visual score 1-10 of places for fish and insects to live (logs, stones, pools).
Water temperature measured with a thermometer.
pH measured with a test strip or pen.
Nitrate measured with a colorimetric test strip.
Phosphate measured with a colorimetric test kit.
Depth at which the marker disappears in a transparency tube.
What is floating on the surface.
Amount of litter in or next to the water.
Dead fish seen in or near the water.
People (e.g. children paddling, swimmers) seen in contact with the water.

concept.display: Pets or livestock in the water
concept.definition: Dogs, livestock or other domestic animals seen in contact with the water.
